storySection.title: A Luxury Print Story
paragraphs: Kohler has long represented classic design, craftsmanship, and luxury. With the introduction of its high-end Vibrant collection of faucets and vessels, the brand required more than a traditional product catalog. They desired a print ad piece that would allow them to convey the haptic beauty of their products in a manner that couldn’t be delivered on screens.

The aim was to develop a print marketing medium that would be greater than a brochure — something that raises the products, speaks luxury, and aids their sales teams both in showrooms and B2B presentations. Time was short, quality expectations were astronomical, and accuracy was not an option. This is where Prakria stepped in.

whyPrakria.title: Why PRAKRIA?
whyPrakria.description: Kohler required a partner who had the ability to blend strategic storytelling with world-class execution. Prakria, as a printing agency and creative studio, bridges the gap between production and concept.
list: Blending strategic storytelling with world-class print execution.
Services ranging from advertising printing and design strategy to high-end production for luxury brands.
Treating each brochure as a brand experience, not just a print product.
Focus on tactile design, layout, and finish to inform brand perception.
Delivering stories in print — not just printed files.

solutionSection.title: Our Solution — A Hyper-Real Experience in Print
solutionSection.description: For the Vibrant line, Prakria created hyper-realistic 3D renderings of every Kohler product, turning each into a visual narrative that conveyed reflection, texture, and metallic glow with lifelike precision.
details: Each rendering was designed to feel almost tangible — a visual story that invited viewers to touch and explore.
These visuals became the foundation of the Vibrant Brochure — combining immersive imagery with refined typography, layout, and narrative.
Lifestyle photography was complemented with material realism to create a multisensory brand experience.

processSection.title: How We Brought It to Life

steps.title: Print Advertisement Design
steps.description: Each spread was crafted to highlight hero products with generous white space, editorial-style layouts, and sharp detail shots — allowing the products to ‘breathe’ like a luxury fashion catalog.

steps.title: Print Media Design
steps.description: Finishes and textures were meticulously selected — matte papers paired with glossy spot finishes to highlight metallic vibrancy, turning each brochure page into a tactile experience.

steps.title: Print Media Advertising Strategy
steps.description: The brochure acted as a storytelling tool across B2B meetings, showroom displays, and client interactions. It was more luxury literature than typical marketing collateral.

steps.title: Advertising Printing Services
steps.description: Partnering with specialized printing companies, every page carried precision and depth. Finishes were tested and approved to meet Kohler’s global quality standards.

steps.title: Print and Media Advertising Integration
steps.description: The brochure became the centerpiece of a broader campaign — extended into showroom posters, print inserts, and collateral that maintained a unified brand story.

impactSection.title: The Impact
impactSection.summary: The Vibrant Brochure proved that print advertising is far from obsolete — when done with precision and creativity, it becomes one of the most powerful storytelling tools available.
results: Retailers praised the premium print design, noting its synergy with Kohler’s showroom experience.
Customers perceived Kohler as even more luxurious, thanks to the tactile storytelling.
The brochure became a benchmark for creative print advertisement in the luxury interiors segment.

standoutSection.title: Why This Project Stands Out
standoutSection.description: In a digital-first world, print advertisement design still plays a unique role — especially for premium products where touch, texture, and physicality matter.
list: Print media advertising allows brands like Kohler to control the sensory experience beyond screens.
Advertising printing services and agencies are key partners in turning ideas into tangible masterpieces.
Print and media advertising excel when they merge strategy, storytelling, and craftsmanship — not just production specs.
standoutSection.conclusion: Prakria’s work on the Kohler Vibrant Brochure demonstrates how precise design, strategic storytelling, and high-end printing can turn a simple brochure into a memorable brand asset.

storySection.title: A Brand Affection Story
paragraphs: Nestlé Nido, particularly in its Ghana business, wanted to go deeper with its primary consumer group — mothers of children between 0–12 years old. The brand was already trusted at the product level, but it sought to be viewed as caring, friendly, and part of everyday family life.

To achieve this, Nido decided to introduce merchandise for special occasions such as 'Back to School' and Ramadan — creating meaningful, tangible touchpoints in daily routines. The challenge: how do you design merchandise that resonates with kids and moms, stays true to brand identity, and works across contexts?
Prakria, acting as a full-spectrum branding agency and creative design studio, partnered with Nido to transform brand values into real, loved objects.

whyPrakria.title: Why PRAKRIA?
whyPrakria.description: Nido needed a partner who could merge local cultural insight with global brand sensibility. Prakria’s experience in brand building, strategy, and creative execution provided confidence that we could deliver more than just attractive merchandise — we could craft a meaningful brand extension.
list: Ability to combine local insight with global design systems.
Strong expertise in brand storytelling, visual identity, and creative merchandising.
Holistic ecosystem approach — merging merchandise, communication, and tactile print experiences.
Beyond design — acted as full branding consultants for the merchandise touchpoint.

solutionSection.title: Our Solution — Designing With Heart and Context
solutionSection.description: We approached Nido’s merchandise design by balancing emotional storytelling, cultural context, and visual consistency.
details: 1. Deep Dive on Consumer Insight: We began by mapping the daily routines of mothers and children — from school prep and playtime to family observances — to identify items that could become meaningful brand touchpoints.
2. Occasions & Themes: Focused on 'Back to School' and 'Ramadan', designing merchandise that felt useful, celebratory, and brand-relevant.
3. Visual Style: Adopted a youthful doodle style while retaining the iconic Nido heart and brand color palette — reinforcing familiarity and emotional warmth.
4. Merchandise Forms & Catalog: Developed a full catalog of branded merchandise (bags, t-shirts, stationery, gifts), rendered in 3D mockups to showcase final real-life outcomes.

processSection.title: How We Brought It to Life

steps.title: Brand Communication & Strategy
steps.description: Each item carried a narrative like 'carry love to school' and 'celebrate with joy' — tying back to Nido’s identity as a caring, family-oriented brand.

steps.title: Print Media Advertising / Merchandise Promotion
steps.description: Posters, flyers, and school handouts were designed to announce the merchandise, build anticipation, and align visually with Nido’s packaging and brand identity.

steps.title: Creative Print Advertisement
steps.description: Flyers and posters mirrored the merchandise’s doodle elements, heart motif, and bright colors — creating one cohesive storytelling system across print and product.

steps.title: Printing Services Coordination
steps.description: We worked closely with boutique printing companies to ensure paper color, texture, and finish matched the vibrant design energy of Nido’s merchandise.

steps.title: Print And Media Advertising Integration
steps.description: Physical and digital touchpoints (retail signage, school posters, online notices) were unified for a consistent omni-channel brand experience.

impactSection.title: The Impact
impactSection.summary: The merchandise campaign built a deep emotional and visual connection between Nido and its core audience of mothers and kids.
results: The Nido heart and colors created instant brand recall, reinforcing identity through merchandise.
Print media advertising boosted anticipation — schools and stores used posters and flyers to draw attention.
The campaign gave Nido cultural and emotional relevance beyond nutrition — making it part of everyday life.

standoutSection.title: Why This Project Stands Out
standoutSection.description: Merchandise is often seen as a giveaway, but this project showed how thoughtful design and storytelling can turn it into a brand-building experience.
list: Print media advertising and promotional collateral aligned deeply with brand visuals.
Branding consultants must extend beyond visual identity into real consumer lives.
Early integration of printing services ensured final products matched design ambition.
Blending print advertising, merchandise, and strategy helped Nido move from transactional to relational branding.
standoutSection.conclusion: Prakria’s collaboration with Nido demonstrates how creative design and brand strategy can transform merchandise into lasting brand equity.

storySection.title: A Bold Refresh Story
paragraphs: Polo Extra Strong has always stood out for its intense flavor and strong personality. But the brand needed a sharper, fresher focus — one that visually conveyed the ‘Extra Strong’ energy across print communications, packaging, and in-store touchpoints.

The new campaign required a key visual that could seamlessly extend across print media advertising, outdoor billboards, in-store displays, and promotional material. It needed to be dynamic, gritty, and unmistakably Polo — while staying true to the brand’s legacy of boldness and clarity.
To achieve this, Polo sought more than a designer — they needed a creative design partner who understood both concept and execution. That’s where Prakria stepped in.

challenge.title: Why Prakria?
challenge.description: Polo chose Prakria because we bridge the gap between creativity and craft. We don’t just design for screens — we design for the real world, where texture, finish, and scale define how visuals are experienced. With deep expertise in print advertising, printing services, and production workflows, we know how to make visuals that retain their power from concept to print.

Full control from creative concept to print production
Focus on scale, finish, and material fidelity
Ability to integrate brand storytelling with print performance
Experience in high-energy FMCG and flavor-forward branding

startageySection.description: We redefined ‘Extra Strong’ not just as a flavor but as a visual energy — a burst of strength and character that could be felt across every medium.

list.title: Defining the Creative Anchor
list.description: We began by exploring what 'Extra Strong' truly means — translating it into a creative language of motion, impact, and power. The slashing ‘X’ shape, drawn from the word 'Extra', became the central motif symbolizing intensity and boldness.

list.title: Visual Language Development
list.description: We crafted a design system using bold contrasts, textured environments, and strong directional motion lines. This gave us a visual framework that could adapt across all print and retail formats while maintaining instant recognition.

list.title: Designing for Print from Day One
list.description: From typography to lighting, every design decision was made with print behavior in mind. We tested layouts across formats — magazines, billboards, and packaging — ensuring visual consistency under varying lighting and material conditions.

list.title: Seamless Production Workflow
list.description: By working closely with trusted printing vendors, we fine-tuned color separations, bleed settings, and finishes to make sure the final output matched the design ambition — vibrant, crisp, and bold.

executionSection.title: How We Brought It to Life
executionSection.description: Once the key visual was finalized, it was expanded into a full print and media advertising toolkit, ensuring consistency across all brand touchpoints.

list.description: Created high-impact outdoor visuals with striking ‘X’ motifs for visibility and brand energy.

list.title: Retail Displays and Shelf Talkers

list.title: Creative Print Advertisement Layouts
list.description: Developed magazine and flyer layouts that balanced storytelling with strong visual punch.

list.title: Technical Print-Ready Files
list.description: Delivered precise print-ready files optimized for different vendors to ensure consistent, high-quality output across formats.

resultSection.title: The Impact
resultSection.description: The new visual identity gave Polo Extra Strong a powerful, attention-grabbing presence in both retail and outdoor advertising.

Outdoor placements drew attention thanks to crisp, high-contrast visuals.
Alignment between design and print production ensured perfectly executed results — crisp, colorful, and impactful.

storySection.title: A Visual Story That Redefined Speed and Flavor
paragraphs: When Nestlé was preparing to introduce the new Grekyo Blueberry Yogurt flavor, the objective was clear: move fast, delight consumers, and make the product instantly recognizable on the shelf.
This refreshing, foreign-inspired flavor required a standout visual that could evoke indulgence, freshness, and the luxurious texture of blueberries at first glance.

But time was a challenge. Traditional studio product shoots were slow and costly — the team needed a faster solution that looked every bit as good as a full-scale shoot. That’s when Nestlé turned to Prakria to bring the idea to life.

Ability to deliver speed without sacrificing visual excellence

list.description: We constructed the hero visual entirely in 3D and CGI — allowing us to render every droplet, swirl, and blueberry with control and precision. The result: a luxurious, creamy visual narrative bursting with flavor.

list.title: Controlling Every Pixel
list.description: By owning the entire process digitally, we could create infinite adaptations — for print advertisement design, packaging, outdoor billboards, and retail communication — all without the delays of physical shoots.

list.title: Visual Consistency and Brand Fidelity
